:::{#exm-logistic-function}
#### Values of the logistic function

The [logistic function](#def-logistic-function) at $z = -2$, $z = 0$ or $z = 2$ has these [values](#def-value):

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
z <- c(-2, 0, 2)
data.frame(z = z, sigmoid = 1 / (1 + exp(-z)))
```

The [value](#def-value) at $z = 0$ is $1 / (1 + e^0) = 1/2$.
The values at $\pm 2$ add to 1; each lies in $(0, 1)$.
:::
